name: Everett Cardoza
source: A polite and well-mannered man who speaks carefully with his words and acts decisively when the time calls for it. His measured words bring on suspicion as it’s hard to tell if he really is a polite man or if he’s simply hiding other intentions. With a strong stocky build and a keen mind, he comes across as one of the more dangerous competitors. Like others… he’s rather quiet about why he’s participating in The Game of Fourtune.
